asset_id.title: Asset Id

path.description: Local filesystem path for CLI / local worker jobs.

OutputContainer.title: OutputContainer

OutputSpec.description:
Output encoding and container specification (docs/plan.md Section 4.1, 8, 10).

Explicitly separates audio format/codec from container per Section 4.1.
Raw .aac is not permitted as an output container because ADTS lacks edit-list
gapless metadata; AAC output always uses the M4A (MP4) container.

format.description: Output format: 'wav' (PCM), 'm4a' (AAC-LC in M4A container), or 'mp3' (MPEG-1 Layer III).

container.description: Output container ('wav', 'm4a', 'mp3'). Automatically derived from format if omitted.

sample_rate.description: Output sample rate in Hz (44100, 48000, or 96000). Internal engine runs at 48000 Hz.
sample_rate.title: Sample Rate

bit_depth.description: PCM bit depth for WAV output (16, 24, or 32). Ignored/null for lossy M4A/MP3 outputs.
bit_depth.title: Bit Depth

bitrate_kbps.description: Target bitrate in kbps for lossy codecs (M4A/MP3). Defaults to 256 kbps when encoding lossy formats.
bitrate_kbps.title: Bitrate Kbps

PresetSpec.description: Preset selection and version specification (docs/plan.md Section 6.10 & 10).

id.description: Preset identifier: 'room' (自然空间), 'surround' (包围感), or 'orbit' (缓慢环绕).

version.description: Explicit preset version string for deterministic reproduction.
version.title: Version

PresetSpec.title: PresetSpec

TimingSpec.description: Timeline synchronization and reverb tail policy (docs/plan.md Section 8 & 10).

mode.description: Timeline synchronization mode. 'preserve' guarantees exact sample alignment.

tail.description: Reverb tail strategy: 'trim' keeps exact input sample length with a short fade-out; 'preserve' appends tail_samples.

fade_out_ms.description: Short fade-out duration in milliseconds applied at the end when tail='trim' to prevent clicks.
fade_out_ms.title: Fade Out Ms

TimingSpec.title: TimingSpec

description:
Unified parameter model shared by CLI, Web GUI, and HTTP API (docs/plan.md Sections 9 & 10).

Supports both standalone render parameter validation and full `POST /v1/jobs` payloads:
```json
{
  "api_version": "v1",
  "mode": "enhance",
  "input": {"asset_id": "asset_example"},
  "preset": {"id": "room", "version": "1"},
  "strength": 0.4,
  "seed": 20261016,
  "output": {"format": "wav", "sample_rate": 48000, "bit_depth": 24},
  "timing": {"mode": "preserve", "tail": "trim"}
}
```

mode.description: Processing mode ('enhance' for V1 stereo/mono binaural enhancement).

input.description: Optional input asset or file reference (required for POST /v1/jobs).

strength.description: Perceptual effect strength in [0.0, 1.0]. Mapped to upmix width, ambient ratio, early reflections, and DRR offset. Dry/wet mixing is forbidden. When 0.0, spatial DSP is bypassed. Defaults to the selected preset's default_strength.
strength.title: Strength

seed.description: Explicit 32-bit unsigned seed for deterministic FDN delay lines and decorrelation filters.
seed.title: Seed

output.description: Output format, container, sample rate, bit depth, and bitrate settings.

timing.description: Timeline synchronization mode and reverb tail handling policy.
